item.title: [News] DeepSeek-V4: a million-token context that agents can actually use
item.description: DeepSeek-V4 is a significant update to the Hugging Face model training framework, providing a million-token context that agents can use. This update matters to IT practitioners as it can be used to deploy more advanced language models with a larger training dataset.

item.title: [News] How to Use Transformers.js in a Chrome Extension
item.description: Hugging Face published a tutorial on using Transformers.js in a Chrome extension, enabling developers to leverage the power of transformer models within web applications. This development is relevant to IT practitioners as it showcases a new use case for transformer-based models in real-world applications.

item.title: [News] Why Business Leaders Need to Champion Democracy
item.description: Democracy is in decline across the world, with 92 countries (74% of the world's population) experiencing erosion of political rights and civil liberties. This trend has significant implications for business leaders and the global economy.

item.title: [News] Towards developing future-ready skills with generative AI
item.description: Google AI released a report on developing future-ready skills with generative AI in education. This matters to IT practitioners as they will need to adapt their technical skills to keep up with the adoption of generative AI in the industry.
